records.text: “And you, son of man, prophesy concerning Israel’s mountains and say to Israel’s mountains, ‘Hear the Lord’s word:
Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because the enemy said over you, “Well done! Everlasting wildernesses have become our possession,”

therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because you were dishonored and hated by those around you, so that you became a possession for the remaining nations, and you became a topic on people’s tongues and a reproach to nations,

therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord to the mountains, hills, ravines, torrents, devastated and destroyed places, and abandoned cities, which became plunder and a trampling place for the remaining nations all around:

Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Surely in the fire of My wrath I have spoken against the remaining nations and all Idumea, because they gave My land to themselves as a possession with rejoicing, dishonoring lives so as to destroy through plunder.

Therefore prophesy over Israel’s land and say to the mountains, hills, ravines and valleys, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and My wrath because you bore the nations’ reproaches.
Therefore I will raise My hand against the nations around you; these will receive their own dishonor.
But your grapes and fruit, mountains of Israel, My people will consume, for they are drawing near.
For behold, I am toward you; I will look upon you, and you will be cultivated and sown.
I will multiply people upon you, all Israel’s house completely. The cities will be inhabited and the devastated land rebuilt.
I will multiply humans and livestock upon you, settle you as at your beginning and do you good as in your former times. You will know that I am the Lord.
I will cause people, My people Israel, to be born upon you. They will inherit you, and you will be their possession. You certainly will no longer be bereaved of them.
Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because they said to you, “You devour human beings and became bereaved by your nation,”
therefore you will no longer eat human beings or bereave your nation, says the Lord, the Lord.
The nations’ dishonor will no longer be heard against you, and you certainly will not bear the peoples’ reproaches, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
“Son of man, Israel’s house lived upon their land and defiled it by their way, their idols and their uncleannesses. Their way before Me became like the uncleanness of a woman sitting apart.
I poured My wrath upon them
and scattered them among the nations and winnowed them into the countries. I judged them according to their way and their sin.
They entered the nations where they entered, and profaned My holy name when it was said of them, ‘These are the Lord’s people, and they have left His land.’
I spared them because of My holy name, which Israel’s house profaned among the nations where they entered.
Therefore say to Israel’s house, ‘Thus says the Lord: I am not acting for you, house of Israel, but because of My holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you entered.
I will sanctify My great name, profaned among the nations, which you profaned among them. The nations will know that I am the Lord when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.
I will take you out of the nations, gather you out of all the lands and bring you into your own land.
I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will be cleansed from all your uncleannesses and all your idols. I will cleanse you.
And I will give you a new heart, and I will give a new spirit within you; and I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh, and give you a heart of flesh.
I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My ordinances, keep My judgments and do them.
You will dwell upon the land I gave your fathers. You will be My people, and I will be your God.
I will save you from all your uncleannesses, summon the grain and multiply it, and will not bring famine upon you.
I will multiply the tree’s fruit and the field’s produce, so that you do not bear the reproach of famine among the nations.
You will remember your evil ways and practices that were not good, and feel disgust before them at your lawless deeds and abominations.
I am not acting because of you, says the Lord, the Lord; this will be known to you. Be ashamed and abashed because of your ways, house of Israel.
Thus says the Lord: On the day I cleanse you from all your lawless deeds, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the wilderness places will be rebuilt.
The devastated land will be worked, instead of lying devastated before every passerby’s eyes.
They will say, “That devastated land has become like a garden of delight, and the deserted, devastated, razed cities stand fortified.”
The nations remaining around you will know that I, the Lord, have rebuilt the razed places and planted the devastated places. I, the Lord, have spoken and will act.
Thus says the Lord: I will also be sought by Israel’s house to do this for them: I will multiply them, human beings like sheep.
Like holy sheep, like Jerusalem’s sheep at her festivals, so the deserted cities will be filled with sheep who are human beings. They will know that I am the Lord.’”
The Lord’s hand came upon me. The Lord brought me out in spirit and set me in the middle of the plain, which was full of human bones.
He led me all around them, and behold, there were very many upon the plain’s surface, very dry.
He said to me, ‘Son of man, will these bones live?’ I said, ‘Lord, Thou knowest these things.’
He said to me, ‘Prophesy over these bones and say to them, Dry bones, hear the Lord’s word:
Thus says the Lord to these bones: Behold, I am bringing the breath of life into you,
and I will put sinews upon you, bring flesh upon you, stretch skin over you and put My Spirit into you. You will live and know that I am the Lord.’
I prophesied as He commanded me. As I prophesied, behold, there was a shaking, and the bones came together, each to its joint.
I saw, and behold, sinews and flesh grew upon them, and skin came up over them, but there was no breath in them.
He said to me, ‘Prophesy, son of man! Prophesy to the breath and say to the breath, Thus says the Lord: Come from the four winds and breathe into these dead, and let them live!’
I prophesied as He commanded me. The breath entered them, and they lived and stood upon their feet, an exceedingly great assembly.
The Lord spoke to me, saying, ‘Son of man, these bones are all Israel’s house, and they say, Our bones have become dry, our hope has perished; we are utterly spent.
Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am opening your tombs and will bring you up from your tombs and into Israel’s land,
and you will know that I am the Lord when I open your graves to bring My people up from the graves.
I will put My Spirit into you, and you will live. I will place you upon your land, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken and will act, says the Lord.’
The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

‘Son of man, take a staff for yourself and write upon it Judah and Israel’s sons attached to him. Take a second staff for yourself and write upon it, For Joseph—Ephraim’s staff—and all Israel’s sons joined to him.
Join them to one another for yourself as one staff, binding them together, and they will be in your hand.
When your people’s sons say to you, Will you not tell us what these things mean to you?

say to them, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I will take Joseph’s tribe through Ephraim’s hand, and Israel’s tribes attached to him, and place them upon Judah’s tribe. They will become one staff in Judah’s hand.
The staffs upon which you wrote will be in your hand before them,

and say to them, Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am taking all Israel’s house from among the nations where they entered, gathering them from all those around them and bringing them into Israel’s land.
I will make them one nation in My land and upon Israel’s mountains, and one ruler will be theirs. They will no longer be two nations or ever again be divided into two kingdoms,

so that they no longer defile themselves with their idols. I will deliver them from all their lawless deeds in which they sinned and cleanse them. They will be My people, and I, the Lord, will be their God.
My servant David will be ruler among them, and one shepherd will be over all, because they will walk in My ordinances, keep My judgments and do them.
They will dwell upon their land, which I gave My servant Jacob, where their fathers dwelt. They will dwell upon it, and David My servant will be their ruler for ever.
I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will set My holy things among them for ever.
My dwelling will be among them. I will be their God, and they will be My people.
The nations will know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them, when My holy things are among them for ever.’
The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face firmly against Gog and the land of Magog, ruler of Rhos, Mosoch and Thobel, and prophesy against him,
and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Rhos, Mosoch and Thobel,
and I will gather you and all your force, horses and horsemen all clothed in breastplates, a great assembly, small shields, helmets and swords,
Persians, Ethiopians and Libyans, all with helmets and small shields;
Gomer and all those around him, the house of Thergama from the farthest north and all those around him, and many nations with you.
Be made ready; prepare yourself, you and all your assembly gathered with you, and you will be a guard for Me.

After many days he will be prepared, and at the end of years he will come and reach the land turned back from the sword, of those gathered from many nations, upon Israel’s land that had been wholly desolate. This one has come out of nations, and all will dwell in peace.
You will come up like rain and arrive like a cloud to cover the land; you will be there, with all those around you and many nations with you.
Thus says the Lord, the Lord: On that day words will rise in your heart, and you will devise evil plans,
and say, “I will go up against an abandoned land; I will come upon those resting quietly and dwelling in peace, all living in a land with no wall or bars, and they have no doors,”

to take plunder and strip their spoils, to turn your hand against the desolate land that was inhabited and against a nation gathered from many nations, acquiring possessions, dwelling upon the earth’s navel.

Saba, Daidan, Carthaginian merchants and all their villages will say to you, “Are you coming for plunder, to plunder and strip spoils? Have you gathered your assembly to take silver and gold, carry away possessions and strip spoils?”
Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, Thus says the Lord: On that day when My people Israel are settled in peace, will you not be roused?
You will come from your place in the farthest north, with many nations beside you, all horse riders, a great assembly and a mighty force,

and come up against My people Israel like a cloud covering the land. It will be at the end of days; I will bring you against My land so that all the nations may know Me when I am sanctified in you before them.
Thus says the Lord, the Lord, to Gog: You are the one of whom I spoke before the former days through My servants, Israel’s prophets, in those days and years, to bring you against them.
On that day, on the day Gog comes against Israel’s land, says the Lord, the Lord, My wrath will rise,
and My jealousy. In the fire of My anger I have spoken: Surely on that day there will be a great shaking upon Israel’s land,

and the sea’s fish, the sky’s birds, the plain’s beasts, every creeping thing upon the earth and every human upon the earth’s face will shake before the Lord. The mountains will split, the ravines will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.
I will summon every fear against him, says the Lord. A man’s sword will be against his brother.
I will judge him with death, blood, flooding rain and hailstones. I will rain fire and sulfur upon him, all those with him and the many nations with him.
I will be magnified, sanctified, glorified and made known before many nations, and they will know that I am the Lord.’”
“And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Rhos, Mosoch and Thobel,
and I will gather you, lead you along, bring you up from the farthest north and bring you upon Israel’s mountains.
I will destroy your bow from your left hand and your arrows from your right hand, and strike you down

upon Israel’s mountains. You and all those around you will fall, and the nations with you will be given to multitudes of birds. I have given you to every flying creature and all the plain’s beasts to be eaten.
Upon the open plain you will fall, for I have spoken, says the Lord.
I will send fire upon Gog, and the islands will be inhabited in peace. They will know that I am the Lord.
My holy name will be known among My people Israel and My holy name will no longer be profaned. The nations will know that I am the Lord, holy in Israel.
Behold, it has arrived, and you will know that it will be, says the Lord, the Lord. This is the day on which I spoke.
Those dwelling in Israel’s cities will go out and burn fires with the weapons: small shields, pikes, bows, arrows, hand staffs and spears. They will burn fires with them for seven years.

They certainly will not take wood from the plain or cut it from the woods; they will burn the weapons with fire. They will plunder those who plundered them and strip those who stripped them, says the Lord.

On that day I will give Gog a notable place, a memorial tomb in Israel, the mass grave of those who came against it, beside the sea. They will build around the valley’s mouth and bury Gog and all his multitude there. It will be called Gai, Gog’s Mass Grave.
Israel’s house will bury them over seven months so that the land may be cleansed.
All the land’s people will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day I was glorified, says the Lord.
They will continually designate men to pass through the land and bury those left upon the land’s surface, to cleanse it after the seven months, and they will search.
Everyone passing through the land who sees a human bone will build a marker beside it until the buriers bury it in Gai, Gog’s Mass Grave.
Indeed, the city’s name will be Mass Grave, and the land will be cleansed.

And you, son of man, say, Thus says the Lord: Say to every flying bird and all the plain’s beasts, Gather and come! Gather from all those around to My sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you, a great sacrifice upon Israel’s mountains. You will eat flesh and drink blood.
You will eat giants’ flesh and drink the blood of the land’s rulers: rams, calves and male goats, and the calves all fattened.
You will eat fat to fullness and drink blood to drunkenness from My sacrifice that I sacrificed for you.
At My table you will be filled with horse and rider, giant and every warrior, says the Lord.
I will set My glory among you, and all the nations will see My judgment that I executed and My hand that I brought upon them.
Israel’s house will know that I am the Lord their God from this day onward.

All the nations will know that Israel’s house was taken captive because of their sins, because they acted faithlessly toward Me. I turned My face from them and handed them into their enemies’ hands, and all fell by the sword.
I dealt with them according to their uncleannesses and lawless acts, and turned My face from them.
Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Now I will reverse Jacob’s captivity, show mercy to Israel’s house and be zealous for My holy name.
They will receive their own dishonor and the injustice they committed when they are settled upon their land in peace, and no one will terrify them,
when I bring them back from the nations and gather them from the nations’ countries; I will be sanctified in them before the nations,
and they will know that I am the Lord their God when I appear to them among the nations.
I will no longer turn My face from them, because I poured My wrath upon Israel’s house, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
